comment: Apache-2.0. Copyright 2026 CYFR Works Inc. Directory HTTP conformance, consumed by CYFR and cyfr.run. Each scenario uses a fresh directory, rate windows and settings; omitted settings use production defaults. Requests are literal JSON objects, serialized compactly with UTF-8; null body means no body. The optional source is presented through a trusted proxy, default 198.51.100.1. Query values are strings. Expect body fields are a top-level subset with exact nested values; omitted fields are unconstrained, null must be present. Only retry_after uses {min,max}, an inclusive integer range, and a header {body_field:retry_after} must equal that returned integer in decimal. Only listed response headers are constrained: names are case-insensitive, values exact. Content-Type is unconstrained; the response body must still decode as JSON except on a 413. A 413 constrains only status because the endpoint owns its error representation. Entry objects in response entries and entry must also appear as canonical JCS bytes on the wire. keys carries unpadded base64url Ed25519 seeds and public keys; entries carries pre-signed canonical JCS strings. Scenarios intentionally omit not_served, read_only and the daily rotation window, which CYFR tests separately.
